old_caption: The video showcases a close-up view of a white marble track with a red ball rolling along it. The track is intricately designed with various curves and loops, set against a plain white background. The camera remains static, capturing the movement of the red ball as it navigates the track's undulating S-shaped curve. The ball rolls along this continuous curve, highlighting the complexity of the track's layout. The lighting is bright, casting subtle shadows to the right that accentuate the contours of the track and the ball's glossy surface. The overall scene is minimalist, emphasizing the interplay between the ball and the track without any additional elements or distractions.
original_wisa_caption: The video showcases a close-up view of a white marble track with a red ball rolling along it. The track is intricately designed with various curves and loops, set against a plain white background. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the movement of the red ball as it navigates through the track's twists and turns. The ball rolls smoothly, demonstrating the precision and smoothness of the track's design. As the ball progresses, it encounters different sections of the track, including a straight path and a loop, highlighting the complexity of the track's layout. The lighting is bright, casting subtle shadows that accentuate the contours of the track and the ball's glossy surface. The overall scene is minimalist, emphasizing the interplay between the ball and the track without any additional elements or distractions.
caption: The video showcases a close oblique view of a long white board with a serpentine groove against an off-white wall. A glossy red ball is already rolling in the channel, while a static AMAKANDU watermark sits in the upper-left corner. The ball rises over rounded crests and drops into troughs, advancing relative to the board as its vertical position oscillates. A thin diagonal seam shifts toward the left frame edge, showing the camera tracking along the surface rather than staying fixed. The ball crosses the seam from left to right while remaining near the center of the view. A bright highlight moves across the ball's curved surface, and pale wood becomes more visible at the lower-right edge. The rolling continues through the last frame without showing how the ball entered the groove or where the track leads afterward.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.

replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.

Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
